scope.exposure: Same informed AI; authored prior F records and outer containment review; knows fifth-window bounds and all names. This is deterministic model information analysis, not a blind or expert experiment.

frozen_model.domain_definition: D_i(g) is the complete deduplicated four-vector list from the frozen entry projection, retaining every original case_id and extra_index as provenance. F03 g→case restrictions remain unchanged.
frozen_model.tagged_state_definition: Omega={(g,z_F01,...,z_F06): z_i in D_i(g) for every i}; one shared g for the complete six-entry tuple.
assumptions: Accept the frozen definite local facts and canonical identities.
The two g states only cover the existing upstream opaque-cap T ambiguity; they do not redefine C/Z/J.
Unknown state-conditioned remainder relations are conservatively enclosed, not certified independent or fully mapped.
frozen_model.case_provenance: Origins are metadata/evidence links, not frequency weights. Preserve all local (g,entry,case_id,extra_index,z) links, choices/aliases/membership and source hash. A numeric state may have multiple algebraic origins; this does not duplicate that numeric state.
frozen_model.geometry_limit: Omega is the fifth conditional algebraic outer union, not a set of certified real drawings or of all possible alternative rule definitions.
frozen_model.all15_pairs: Keep the frozen six-entry/15-pair catalogue and original fifth-window intervals. This window conditions the fixed H,H4,H-H4 objectives; it does not newly require conditional bounds for each individual S pair. F02 irrelevance does not apply to its individual S pairs.
frozen_model.H_minus_H4: H-H4, evaluated on the same full assignment; not independently assembled marginal endpoints.
frozen_model.arithmetic: Exact rational values; implementation may store integer numerators over 32 and reduce for display. All >0 predicates are strict; zero never passes and no numerical epsilon is introduced.

ideal_observation.unit: One selected entry reveals its entire original four-coordinate capped signature as one tuple. Never choose coordinatewise observations or combine per-coordinate witnesses.
ideal_observation.subsets: All 64 subsets of the six fixed entries, including empty and full, with no outcome-driven omissions.
ideal_observation.mask: Integer 0..63, bit0=F01, bit1=F02, bit2=F03, bit3=F04, bit4=F05, bit5=F06.
not_acquired: No claim the original image can yield the ideal signature.
No claim a new expert, higher-resolution photo or actual acquisition will resolve it.
Known g is a conditional thought experiment about an operational interpretation, not an assumption that photography can reveal a historical hidden parameter.
ideal_observation.information_cost: Number of selected whole entries is a combinatorial budget only. Report knowing g separately; do not assign a monetary/time cost or equate knowing g with one entry.

regimes.condition: g remains shared and unknown; retain every compatible global state.
Condition the entire model on g=terminal_region_reading.
Condition the entire model on g=opaque_boundary_reading.

fibers.definition: For regime R, subset S and exact observed tuple y, Omega_R(S,y)={omega in Omega_R: z_i=y_i for all i in S}.
fibers.feasible_observations: Y_R(S) is the exact projection of Omega_R onto the selected complete entry tuples, deduplicated lexicographically. Complete finite tables cover every y in Y_R(S).
fibers.ambient_query_alphabet: Use each entry global-union domain D_i^union=union_g D_i(g), sorted lexicographically, for UI/domain IDs; a choice can be globally legal yet incompatible with known g or other selected entries. Do not silently replace it by a branch-specific alternative.
fibers.conflict: A schema-valid complete tuple with no compatible state is CONFLICT. Return counts zero, bounds null, no positive/nonpositive certificate. Do not apply vacuous all-positive logic or classify it NONE_JOINT_POSITIVE.
fibers.invalid_input: Wrong entry IDs, duplicate contradictory assignments, unknown g labels, wrong length or non-integer/out-of-range components are INPUT_ERROR. A correctly shaped signature outside its global-union domain is a model conflict, not a fabricated feasible observation.
fibers.conflict_population: Store all feasible fibers, not the enormous ambient collection of empty fibers. Query/fixture conflicts are separately recorded; no numerical prevalence of conflicts is implied.

classification.predicate: P(omega)=(H(omega)>0 and H4(omega)>0) on the same full assignment.

ordered_rules.when: fiber nonempty and P holds for every compatible state
fiber nonempty and P holds for no compatible state
at least one compatible state satisfies P and at least one does not

classification.equivalence: For a nonempty finite fiber, ALL_JOINT_POSITIVE iff min H>0 and min H4>0. Existence of a jointly positive state is NOT established by max H>0 and max H4>0 separately.
classification.negative_label_limit: NONE_JOINT_POSITIVE means no state in this declared model passes both necessary inequalities. It does not mean both objectives are nonpositive everywhere, and does not prove a negative or absent real historical effect.
classification.resolving_uncertainty: A decisive outcome is ALL_JOINT_POSITIVE or NONE_JOINT_POSITIVE. Preserve the category; do not merge favorable and unfavorable resolutions into an acquisition success rate.

counts_and_denominators.tagged_state_count: Number of distinct (g,full six-entry signature tuple) in the fiber, not original case/r multiplicity.
counts_and_denominators.deduplicated_state_count: Number of distinct full six-entry signature tuples after removing g duplicates.
counts_and_denominators.positive_counts: Both tagged and deduplicated counts of states satisfying P; P depends on z only, so removing g duplicates cannot change any bound or class.
counts_and_denominators.known_g: For one known g, tagged and deduplicated numeric-state counts are equal.
counts_and_denominators.fiber_count: For each regime and each of 64 subsets, number of distinct feasible observation tuples y, plus exact counts in the three nonempty classes. Sum of class counts equals feasible-fiber count.
counts_and_denominators.known_g_comparison: Report both known-g regimes separately. No g averaging. For guarantees before g is learned, also report whether the same S is decisive for every feasible outcome in both known-g regimes.
counts_and_denominators.no_probability: All counts are finite set cardinalities, not probabilities, empirical frequencies, independent sample sizes, likelihoods, entropy or historical plausibilities. No uniform prior over g, signatures or origins is introduced.
counts_and_denominators.original_origin_count: If reported, count local original case/r instances separately and label them provenance; never use them to weight fibers or scores.

primary_subset_existence_minimal.definition: For each regime R and each target class C in {ALL_JOINT_POSITIVE,NONE_JOINT_POSITIVE,DECISIVE_EITHER}, E_C(S) means there exists some feasible y with that class (or either decisive class). S is inclusion-minimal when E_C(S) and no proper subset T has E_C(T). All tied sets are reported; minimum cardinality is a separate summary, not a unique selected winner.
primary_subset_existence_minimal.meaning: A possible ideal result can decide the model; this does not guarantee that the actually obtained result would decide it.

outcome_specific_minimal_certificate.definition: For a particular decisive feasible (S,y), T subset S is a minimal certificate when class(T,y restricted to T) equals its decisive class and no proper U subset T has that class. All such T are retrievable. A proper feasible projection cannot have the opposite decisive class.
outcome_specific_minimal_certificate.difference: This is not subset existence-minimality: a smaller T might decide some other observed value while failing to decide the current y. Do not conflate the two.

guarantee_minimal.definition: G_R(S) means every y in Y_R(S) is decisive, irrespective of which of the two decisive classes occurs. Report all inclusion-minimal S satisfying it, and minimum cardinality. Also show the all-known-g guarantee G_t(S) and G_o(S), without selecting a favorable g.
guarantee_minimal.singletons: For each singleton distinguish every outcome mixed, some decisive but some mixed, and every outcome decisive. Cannot guarantee is not equivalent to never helps.

minimality.empty_and_full: If a regime is already decisive without observations, the empty set is the relevant minimal certificate. Complete six signatures fix H/H4 independently of g, so feasible full-observation fibers cannot be MIXED.
minimality.cost_and_ties: No adaptive acquisition policy, cost ranking or outcome probability is inferred. Do not select one minimal set and suppress other incomparable/tied sets.

proof_preconditions: F02 has coefficient zero in H and H4, hence in their difference and P.
The frozen domain D_F02(g) is the same nonempty set D2 in both g states.

Each fixed-g outer numeric model is the stated product, with no extra F02-to-other-entry identity or relation constraint beyond the common g; all original source constraints are retained in the outer interpretation.
F02_factorization.proof: Let U be a subset not containing F02 and v in D2. Projecting Omega_R(U,y) or Omega_R(U union {F02},(y,v)) onto (g,all other five signatures) gives exactly the same set. Inclusion from right to left is conditioning; from left to right append v, which belongs to D2 for every retained g. Since objectives/P ignore F02, all bounds, compatible g and classes are identical. Zero objective coefficient alone would not prove this if F02 revealed g.
F02_factorization.compact_representation: Exactly enumerate the 32 canonical subsets over [F01,F03,F04,F05,F06] in all three regimes. Supply an explicit map/decoder for all 64 logical subsets and all feasible F02 values. This is lossless factorization, not omission of F02.
F02_factorization.count_factors: Let q=|D2| and let n_core be a distinct five-signature (tagged or deduplicated) fiber count. For a logical subset not observing F02, full-state and positive counts equal q*n_core. If F02 is observed at any valid v, they equal n_core. Feasible observation/class-fiber counts for a subset observing F02 equal q times those for its canonical subset. No F02 observation does not multiply the number of distinct y. Preserve the same formulas separately for tagged and deduplicated counts.
F02_factorization.origin_expansion: For any returned full state, unobserved F02 may use a deterministic first D2 value as a witness, or any explicitly requested valid value; observed F02 must use the observed value. Resolve all compatible original F02 case/r links through the frozen provenance index, not through an invented empty origin.
F02_factorization.minimality_consequence: Within the checked model, no inclusion-minimal decisive certificate, existence-minimal set or guarantee-minimal set needs F02: removing it preserves the relevant classification. Still report every logical subset containing it and verify the mapping.
F02_factorization.limited_target: No claim F02 has no information about individual S(F02,j), its drawing, its name or a different model.

required_outputs.input_manifest: Exact hashes of fifth observation, full state-conditioned domains and origins, model formulas, named branches, proof assumptions and this final reviewed contract.
required_outputs.state_dictionary: Stable g IDs and lexicographic global-union whole-signature IDs per entry; source hash and complete (g,entry,z)→case/r index retaining aliases/choices.
required_outputs.canonical_state_table: May store distinct five-entry tagged states and exact H/H4/difference numerators as a compact deterministic array, with optional dedup tuple IDs. This permits any full witness to be reconstructed and does not weight origins.
required_outputs.fiber_table: Every feasible canonical (regime,32-subset-mask,observed tuple) with compatible g mask, exact H/H4/difference lower/upper numerators, tagged/dedup remaining-state counts, tagged/dedup joint-positive counts and class. Fixed field dictionary/schema and sorted row order mandatory.
required_outputs.logical_64_index: All 64 six-entry masks, canonical mask, F02 observed flag, exact expansion/count factors, each regime feasible-fiber totals and complete class counts.
required_outputs.minimum_sets: All primary existence-minimal sets per class/regime, guarantee-minimal sets, minimum cardinalities and singleton three-way descriptions. All outcome-specific certificates must be exactly retrievable from the full table; materializing duplicate lists in every row is not required.
required_outputs.witnesses: Deterministic query/replay access to extrema and one positive/nonpositive full-state witness when present, including shared g and compatible source case/r IDs. Store witnesses for every reported minimal-set example; other witnesses can be reconstructed from the frozen state table. Ties need not have identical witnesses across independent algorithms, but every witness must validate.
required_outputs.storage: Compressed/chunked deterministic JSON arrays or equally documented lossless format are allowed. Manifest every chunk, give a complete decoder and no silently dropped or sampled rows. Numbers of feasible observations are model cardinalities, never rates of future success.
required_outputs.interpretation_report: All favorable/unfavorable/mixed outcomes and full denominators, limits of ideal information/known g, conditional suggestions, remaining image/history evidence and inherited information-loss warning. No claim that an exact signature can actually be acquired.

validation_before_real_analysis.fixture: One state (H,H4)=(0,1/4) is NONE; (1/4,1/4) is ALL; an empty fiber is CONFLICT with null bounds.
validation_before_real_analysis.scope: Artificial objective records; no manuscript input.

validation_before_real_analysis.test: Marginal positive maxima without a joint-positive state
validation_before_real_analysis.fixture: Two artificial states have (H,H4)=(1/4,-1/4) and (-1/4,1/4). Both marginal maxima are positive; joint-positive count is zero and class must be NONE_JOINT_POSITIVE.
validation_before_real_analysis.scope: Classifier unit test; it is not claimed to be a real F completion.

validation_before_real_analysis.test: Duplicated g and redundant original origins
validation_before_real_analysis.fixture: Duplicate one full z under both g, and duplicate its case/r origin records. g-tagged state count can exceed unique-z count; origin duplication must change neither count after numeric-state dedup nor any score/class.
validation_before_real_analysis.scope: Synthetic records with exact expected counts declared in implementation fixture.

validation_before_real_analysis.test: Global-g conflict, never mixed per entry
validation_before_real_analysis.fixture: Synthetic g=t permits F01=u and F03=u; g=o permits F01=v and F03=v, u!=v. Observing (u,v) conflicts although both components occur in the global union. Fixed-g observation outside its branch also conflicts.

validation_before_real_analysis.assertions: Use unchanged H/H4 formulas. Compare every feasible fiber of all64 subsets and all3 regimes, exact counts, bounds, joint predicates and every minimal-set definition against a separate direct enumeration.

validation_before_real_analysis.test: F02 relevance counterexample when a premise fails
validation_before_real_analysis.fixture: In a synthetic model F02=a only at g=t and F02=b only at g=o; the other entries give different decisive classes across those g. Even with zero objective coefficient, learning F02 can reveal g. Factorization must reject unequal domains.
validation_before_real_analysis.scope: Proves the need for equal-domain/product premises, not a claim about real F02.

validation_before_real_analysis.fixture: Two binary observed entries A,B; decision predicate false for A=0, and for A=1 depends on B. For outcome A=1,B=1 the pair can be an outcome-minimal certificate although A alone already has a decisive result at A=0.
validation_before_real_analysis.assertion: Existence-minimal DECISIVE and per-outcome certificate tables must differ as defined, not be silently merged.

validation_before_real_analysis.assertions: Every feasible refinement is a subset of its coarser fiber; min cannot decrease, max cannot increase. Decisive classes persist under feasible refinement. Full signatures imply no MIXED even if duplicate g remains. Empty-set bounds reproduce each base regime.

On a tiny equal-domain product fixture, expanded64 results, full-state counts, feasible-fiber counts and local minimality equal brute-force64 outputs. Invalid F02 gives conflict, never a substitute value.

real_analysis_acceptance.approval: Only after parent has reviewed independent method/code/toy evidence and bound the implementation/input hashes; this proposal does not authorize formal real analysis.
checks: All64 logical subsets and all3 regimes present with deterministic expansion; no favorable subset selection.
Whole-vector conditional fibers and one shared g maintained.
Tagged/dedup state and joint-positive counts, exact bounds and classifications independently agree for all feasible fibers, not merely selected examples.
All minimality definitions independently checked, including F02 irrelevance and singleton distinctions.
All source identities/origins remain queryable; unknown mappings and geometric nonattainability limits not deleted.
Prior fifth empty-set published intervals match the saved reference without treating this as image validation.
Old fourth/fifth scientific files and historical outcomes/errata remain unchanged.
real_analysis_acceptance.independence: Different implementation/review path under the same informed AI; no claim of independent historical observations.
real_analysis_acceptance.failure: A missing/invalid origin, mismatched count, unhandled coupling or incomplete enumeration is reported, not repaired by dropping rows or selecting successful subsets. Computation limits produce explicit incomplete status and retained artifacts, not sampled claims of full coverage.

prohibitions: No images, new source acquisition, morphology recoding, lexical translation or new Voynich scores.
No retuning of four coordinates/cap2, source scopes, names, coefficient weights or positivity thresholds after results.
No probabilities from equal counting, no expected acquisition utility, no independence claim from a Cartesian outer relaxation.
No favorable g selection or treating separate favorable H and H4 endpoints as jointly positive.
No deleting F02/low-resolution F06 or silently changing old failures to completed image qualification.
